name: Breeg's Traps
disable: DC 17 Survival check (made as an individual hexploration activity) to locate and disarm all the traps by hand.
reset: There are enough traps in this hex that this hazard can be triggered up to 5 times before all the traps are used up.

items.name: Clamp Shut
items.text:
Trigger Anyone Travels or Reconnoiters this hex

---

Effect If the characters are Traveling, one of them (determined randomly) steps in a trap. If the characters are Reconnoitering, 1d4 of them (determined randomly) step in a trap. When a creature steps in a trap, the trap makes a bear trap Strike against the creature.

text:
Several dozen spike snares are littered across this hex.

---

Treasure: Each time a PC triggers a trap, the trap is destroyed. If all the traps are disabled, materials to craft six spike snares can be salvaged.
